name: Pecém data center (TikTok)
locality: Pecém industrial and port complex, São Gonçalo do Amarante
status_note: ByteDance's largest data center outside China (Bloomberg); works began Jan 2026, first module due mid-2027. Reports give 200 MW contracted by ByteDance and 300 MW planned.

construction_start.note: O Povo, 15 Jan 2026: TikTok data center starts works at Pecém.
